title: code-review-mcp-server: Command injection via unsanitized folderPath/baseBranch parameters (CVE-2026-68934)
description: code-review-mcp-server versions prior to 1.5.3 contain a command injection vulnerability in several MCP tools that accept folderPath and baseBranch parameters. These parameters are unsafely interpolated into shell commands executed via child_process.execSync(), allowing an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the host. The issue is fixed in version 1.5.3 by replacing execSync() calls with execFileSync() and passing arguments directly to git/gh without shell interpretation.
